title: Frontier Incoming Agents and Relay Placement: Reaching 90% Handover Consistency
target_platform: Claude Haiku 5.5 / Gemini 3.8 Flash via cli-agent as incoming agents; local Qwen2.5-Coder-7B via MLX for the placement arm
hypothesis: On fresh held-out handover questions (new seed, same generators), a frontier incoming agent (Claude Haiku 5.5 or Gemini 3.8 Flash) given the Predecessor Relay in its boot briefing answers >= 90% correctly with zero tool calls on >= 90% of questions, against <= 55% for the same agent without the relay; and placing the relay at the top of the briefing lifts the local 7B from 68.2% (MISSION-025) to >= 80%.
falsification_criteria: A frontier agent with the relay scores < 90% correct or needs tools on > 10% of questions; or the control gap is < 25 points; or relay-first placement does not lift the local 7B by >= 10 points on fresh questions; or any wrong-but-confident answer contradicts a fact that was present in the relay (more than 1 in 22).
baseline_evidence: MISSION-025 (22 questions, local Qwen 7B, temperature 0): control 22.7% (median 5 turns, 2.5 tool calls), with relay 68.2% (median 2 turns, 1.27 tool calls, +45.5 points). All 7 misses had the answer present in the relay: the agent ignored the briefing and dug with tools (4), copied a format placeholder (1), or confused ids in one note (2).

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Not applicable; the mission compares incoming agents.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.
